proposed_widenings.name: DiceAmount.resource_remaining_linear
proposed_widenings.justification: Retributive Strike damage scales from the current remaining charges in the staff, not from slot level, fixed dice, or charges spent on a spell cast.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "you take Force damage equal to 16 times the number of charges in the staff"

proposed_widenings.name: Attachment.area exclude_source filter
proposed_widenings.justification: The explosion affects other creatures in the area while the bearer resolves through a separate avoidance branch and self-damage rule.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "Each other creature in the area makes a DC 17 Dexterity saving throw."

proposed_widenings.name: last_charge_roll_outcomes
proposed_widenings.justification: The current destruction policy only handles destruction on last-charge roll. Staff of Power instead needs branching outcomes that can partially suppress item properties or restore charges.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a 1, the staff retains its +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls but loses all other properties. On a 20, the staff regains 1d8 + 2 charges."

notes: Top-level fit exists as a composite magic item, but the current surface cannot encode remaining-charge-based damage, area exclusion of the bearer, or the partial-depower / recharge last-charge branch honestly. No content or trace file was authored.
